title: Senior/Staff Platform Software Engineer (PHP/Angular)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior/Staff Platform Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience to join our U.S. client. The role focuses on designing, building, and evolving the foundational systems that power the products. This role requires an experienced engineer with strong hands-on expertise in PHP and TypeScript (Angular) who can operate with minimal oversight and deliver pragmatic, customer-focused solutions.

The ideal candidate is an engineer who already possesses deep technical expertise, architectural judgment, and product-oriented thinking — and can apply those skills immediately in a production environment.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class property management system integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable platform services using PHP as a primary backend language
  • Build and maintain frontend systems using TypeScript and Angular
  • Architect and evolve shared platform capabilities used across multiple products and teams
  • Translate product requirements into pragmatic, maintainable technical solutions
  • Apply Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles and architectural modeling to complex business domains
  • Make sound tradeoffs between ideal architecture and practical delivery timelines
  • Build and integrate systems leveraging LLM-based tools to accelerate development workflows
  • Design and implement features powered by LLMs and agent-based systems, including orchestration, evaluation, and observability
  • Improve engineering velocity through tooling, automation, and thoughtful system design
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product and design teams to ensure technical decisions align with customer needs
  • Contribute to cloud architecture decisions and ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost-aware


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Deep, production-grade experience with PHP
  • Strong front-end development experience using TypeScript and Angular
  • Experience designing and operating distributed systems in production
  • Strong understanding of API design, RESTful services, and event-driven systems and solid knowledge of relational databases and data modeling
  • Practical experience applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) concepts and architectural models (layered architecture, hexagonal/clean architecture, event-driven architecture, etc.)
  • Demonstrated ability to evolve legacy systems incrementally
  • Ability to design systems that balance correctness, scalability, cost, and delivery speed
  • Hands-on experience deploying and operating systems in AWS, with familiarity with core AWS services (e.g., EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, RDS, S3, API Gateway, CloudWatch, IAM) and strong understanding of cloud-native patterns, scalability, reliability, and cost optimization
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK) is strongly preferred
  • Hands-on experience using LLM-based tools in daily development workflows
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into production systems
  • Familiarity with prompt design, evaluation strategies, and reliability patterns
  • Ideally: experience building features or internal tools powered by LLM agents, including orchestration, tool use, guardrails, and monitoring
  • Strong product mindset with p ragmatic decision-maker — prioritizes customer impact over theoretical purity and avoids dogmatic adherence to patterns or tools
  • Experience making technical tradeoffs in ambiguous environments
  • Ability to reason about cost, complexity, maintainability, and time-to-market
  • Highly self-motivated and accountable, with the ability to drive initiatives independently from concept to production with minimal oversight
  • Comfortable operating in environments with evolving requirements


Desired Experience

  • Experience with other major cloud providers (GCP or Azure) is a plus
  • Experience defining platform strategy or technical direction across teams
  • Experience mentoring engineers and raising overall engineering standards
  • Proven track record of modernizing systems at scale
  • Experience designing developer platforms or internal tooling ecosystems
  • Strong opinions loosely held — able to debate rigorously and adapt when new information emerges


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Job Title: Bilingual Talent Acquisition Specialist

Location: Brazil (Remote Position)

Start Date: ASAP

Length: Permanent (Full-Time)

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills - C1
  • Spanish verbal communication skills - B2


Description:

· Recruit solid information technology and engineering professionals in different countries, such as Brazil, Colombia, United States, Mexico, Canada, etc.

· Execute sourcing and engagement strategies designed to identify qualified active and passive candidates through various sourcing channels.

· Develop and maintain a network of contacts to identify qualified, diverse, and talented candidates; maintain current market knowledge and external trends.

· Build and maintain meaningful and trusted relationships that result in dynamic hiring candidate experiences.

· Work on the job description and job posting for each assigned open requirement to be able to post on social media.

· Execute the full life cycle recruiting process, including sourcing, interviewing, presenting candidates, and negotiating offers.

· Execute recruitment plan by aggressively recruiting for well-qualified candidates from a variety of sources, managing selection process to include interviewing, assessing candidates, screening, research, cold calling, and filling the staffing needs within the defined service and performance criteria.

· Maintain the data integrity within the Applicant Tracking System.


Skills and Qualifications

· Bachelor’s degree preferred.

· 3-5 years' experience in full-cycle recruiting/sourcing for both exempt and non-exempt roles.

· Ability to work well in a team environment and maximize team performance, while maintaining a working environment that’s fun and professionally rewarding

· Ability to balance and manage many simultaneous competing priorities with multiple profiles.

· Ability to work independently and make decisions with limited information.

· Experience with use of Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), Microsoft Office (e.g, Word, Excel, PowerPoint), career portals and AI Tools.

· Demonstrate responsibility by independently managing tasks, meeting deadlines, and maintaining high-quality work standards in a remote environment.

· Previous IT Recruiting experience is preferred.

· Excellent English verbal and written communication skills.

· Good Spanish verbal and written communication skills.

title: Business Development Manager - LatAm Focus
description:
The Mandate: Forging New Paths to Prosperity


We are seeking a full-time BDM with a proven client portfolio and the confidence to open entirely new markets for our portfolio.


✅ Key Responsibilities:


  • Strategic Client Acquisition: Proactively develop and secure new clients, with a sharp focus on expanding Fa Chai Gaming's presence and securing major deals across Central and South America.
  • Market Intelligence & Strategy: Submit regular, insightful reports on regional business developments and market trends, providing actionable recommendations to guide our strategic decision-making and product adaptation.
  • Ambassador & Host: Represent Fa Chai Gaming at key iGaming exhibitions and industry events, adeptly hosting clients and nurturing new business relationships face-to-face.
  • Relationship Nurturing: Undertake periodic business trips across the region to maintain and deepen strategic client relationships, ensuring high client satisfaction and sustained commercial growth.


What Brings You Fortune (Requirements & Skills)


  • Language Mastery: Demonstrated proficiency in both English and Portuguese (Spanish is a strong plus).
  • Industry Experience: Minimum 3 years of professional sales experience in the online gaming/iGaming B2B sector.
  • Existing Client Resources: Must possess an established and active network of operator contacts within the LatAm market, with a proven ability to convert leads into major commercial partnerships.
  • Industry Preference: Candidates with previous sales or business development experience working for established European or American gaming providers/platforms will be strongly preferred.
  • Market Expertise: A deep understanding of the regulatory landscape, operator needs, and player preferences within the Central and South American market is a strong advantage.
  • Location Advantage: A current base of operations within Brazil or a major LatAm market hub is highly desirable.


Are you ready to build a new empire for Fa Chai Gaming and take the lead in LatAm?


If you have the network, the drive, and the ambition to succeed in a fast-paced environment where growth is the ultimate metric, apply now.

title: Advogado(a) Pleno | Contencioso Cível
description:
Aqui, você não é apenas um número. Você é protagonista.


Atribuímos à lealdade e à parceria os nossos valores mais intrínsecos. Estamos de peito aberto para escutar e construir um resultado coletivo, integrado entre os nossos profissionais e os nossos clientes.


Somos um escritório de advocacia preparado para entender, no detalhe, as necessidades de cada caso, comunicando-se sempre da forma mais clara e inteligível.


Como um escritório abrangente e altamente qualificado , proporcionamos soluções jurídico estratégicas por meio de uma equipe experiente e informada, movida pela atitude de facilitar as vias das soluções jurídicas, com base em informações completas e seguras das tradicionais até as mais inovadoras.


Queremos e conseguimos ser uma extensão estratégica dos nossos clientes, oferecendo as soluções eficientes e duradouras, adaptadas para cada individualidade.


Juntos, nós seguimos na direção de um caminho justo e coerente.


Cargo: Advogado(a) Pleno em Contencioso Cível


Missão do Cargo:

Atuar em casos litigiosos de forma técnica e eficiente, garantindo que os clientes recebam orientação jurídica clara e suporte confiável, contribuindo para a solução dos processos e para a estratégia do escritório.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:


  • Atuação em casos litigiosos no geral, com exposição a diferentes áreas do contencioso, incluindo família e sucessões.
  • Reuniões com clientes para esclarecimento de dúvidas e alinhamento de estratégias.
  • Elaboração de peças processuais e acompanhamento do andamento dos processos, garantindo qualidade técnica e cumprimento de prazos.
  • Diligências presenciais e levantamento de informações junto a órgãos públicos e tribunais.
  • Suporte à equipe na análise de casos e preparação de documentos jurídicos, mantendo comunicação clara com clientes e colegas.


Requisitos:


  • Formação em Direito (registro ativo na OAB).
  • Experiência prévia em contencioso cível.
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento com clientes.
  • Organização, comprometimento com prazos e atenção a detalhes.
  • Desejável experiência em família e sucessões.


Benefícios:


  • Salário competitivo;
  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Reembolso de atividade física;
  • Estacionamento ou auxílio mobilidade;
  • Plano de desenvolvimento;
  • Bônus.


Regime de Trabalho

  • Modelo híbrido: 4 dias presenciais e 1 dia remoto .

Atuar em casos litigiosos de forma técnica e eficiente, garantindo que os clientes recebam orientação jurídica clara e suporte confiável, contribuindo para a solução dos processos e para a estratégia do escritório.

title: Engenharia de Dados AWS
description:
Já conhece a GFT?

Com mais de 40 anos de mercado e localizada em 20 países, a GFT emprega mais de 12.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo quase 5.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Sênior que atue com Dados e AWS.



Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Experiência avançada em AWS e seus principais serviços para engenharia de dados (S3, Glue, Lambda, Redshift, DynamoDB, Athena, etc.).
  • Domínio de linguagens de programação como Python para manipulação e processamento de dados.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de orquestração de dados, como Apache Airflow ou AWS Step Functions.
  • Experiência em banco de dados relacional e não relacional (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB).
  • Familiaridade com boas práticas de segurança em ambientes AWS (IAM, KMS, criptografia de dados).
  • Experiência em soluções de streaming de dados (Kafka, Kinesis).
  • Conhecimento em controle de versão e pipelines de CI/CD utilizando ferramentas como GitHub, Jenkins, ou CodePipeline.


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:

  • Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;
  • Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;
  • Programas de incentivo à Certificações;
  • Horário de trabalho flexível;
  • Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;
  • Salários competitivos;
  • Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;
  • Gympass;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Auxílio-Creche;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida.



Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
About Us :



Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.



Where you Fit In



You'll be a key player within the Sportingtech Team and joining a group of highly skilled professionals, with a pivotal responsibility in creating performing and scalable Java-based solutions across our award-winning iGaming Platform.



Who are You ?



As a Senior Java developer you'll become a part of our multinational Scrum teams to create state-of-the-art software solutions. In all teams we cooperate with internal and external experts from different knowledge domains to discover and build the best solutions possible.


Technologies Used:



Java 8+, Spring Boot, RabbitMQ, Kafka, JDBC, NoSQL, Relational Databases, PostgreSQL, AWS, Dynatrace



The Impact you will have:



  • Software Development: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, architects, and other stakeholders to design, develop, test, and deploy robust Java applications
  • Code Quality: Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code while following best practices and coding standards. Also guide less senior engineers towards Test driven development.
  • Technical Analysis: Analyze and troubleshoot complex technical issues, providing innovative solutions and improvements.
  • Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation to aid in code understanding and future enhancements.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with team members, including architects, developers, and QA’s, to deliver high-quality software in a timely fashion. Also mentor in different areas less experienced engineers.
  • Performance Optimization: Identify and implement performance enhancements, scalability improvements, and code optimizations.
  • Technology Stack: Stay up to date with the latest Java-related technologies and frameworks to recommend and implement the best solutions.
  • Code Reviews: Collaborate with the Team Lead to drive and standarise code reviews to ensure code quality and adherence to standards.
  • Security: Implement security best practices and contribute to maintaining the security of applications.
  • Agile Development: Embrace agile development methodologies, such as Scrum or Kanban, to facilitate project delivery.



What we’re looking for:




  • Strong experience with JDBC, JDBI or ORM tools
  • Practical experience and a strong grasp of Java concurrency
  • Development of distributed systems
  • High level proficiency and skills in at least one of the following technologies: AMQP, ZeroMQ, JMS, Kafka
  • Strong experience with MVC frameworks
  • Knowledge of Spring and Spring Boot
  • Proficient in SQL
  • Understanding of principles of the Clean Architecture
  • Proficiency in backend development, including Rest API practice
  • Proficiency in principles of the Clean Architecture
  • Expert in creating automated unit and integration tests
  • Proficiency of multi-thread applications, OOP & MVC concepts and design patterns
  • Proficiency with Git or other version control systems.




Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

title: Data Integration Engineer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role


The Data Integration Engineer position focuses on designing and building ETL pipelines that connect diverse data sources. This role involves ensuring data quality and reliability, collaborating with analytics and engineering teams in a dynamic environment, and implementing data quality checks and monitoring to maintain accuracy while optimizing pipelines for performance and scalability.


Key responsibilities


- Designing and developing ETL pipelines to integrate data from multiple sources.

- Building and maintaining data integration workflows using modern tools and frameworks.

- Collaborating with data engineers and analysts to understand integration requirements and deliver effective solutions.

- Implementing data quality checks and monitoring to ensure accuracy and reliability across pipelines.

- Optimizing data pipelines for performance and scalability to support growing business needs.

- Documenting integration processes and providing technical support to stakeholders.


Requirements


- Data Integration Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience in data integration or ETL development.

- SQL and Transformation: Strong knowledge of SQL and data transformation techniques.

- ETL Tools: Experience with ETL tools and data integration platforms.

- Technical Skills: Familiarity with APIs, databases, and cloud data services.

- Data Quality: Understanding of data quality principles and best practices.

- Language Proficiency: Advanced level of English.



Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Desenvolvedor Unreal Engine
description:
Programador Unreal (Pleno / Sênior / Especialista / Não aceitamos Juniors)Descrição da Vaga

Somos um estúdio indie em plena expansão. Estamos desenvolvendo um MMORPG de nova geração e outros 2 projetos próprios, e buscamos programadores de Unreal Engine que queiram crescer conosco em projetos reais de longo prazo. Aceitamos candidatos de qualquer país da América Latina. O trabalho é 100% remoto .

Site do estúdio:

Níveis que buscamos
  • Pleno (Normal-Medium) — Programadores com base sólida em C++ e conhecimento funcional de Unreal Engine 5. Capazes de receber instruções claras e executar com qualidade. Dispostos a aprender, melhorar constantemente e contribuir em projetos reais.
  • Sênior (Muito Bom) — Programadores com experiência comprovada em projetos com Unreal Engine. Domínio sólido de C++, Blueprints e pelo menos uma área especializada (replicação, otimização, sistemas de gameplay, UI, etc.). Capazes de resolver problemas complexos com autonomia e critério.
  • Especialista/Senior+ — Programadores sêniores com trajetória demonstrável em projetos complexos e multiplayer. Experiência sólida em replicação de rede (network replication), otimização de performance e arquitetura de sistemas. Capazes de liderar equipes, tomar decisões técnicas de alto nível, organizar outros programadores e documentar sistemas complexos.
Observação: Cada nível deve ser comprovado e demonstrado com portfólio, projetos anteriores ou teste técnico. Não buscamos diplomas — buscamos capacidade real.

title: Tech Lead Salesforce Developer
description:
Tech Lead Salesforce Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Research Engineer, RL Environments
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, RL Environments to help design and build frontier-quality RL environments, reward systems, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to translate their post-training and RL goals into concrete environment specs — designing tasks with verifiable outcomes, building reward and verifier systems, and ensuring environments are robust against reward hacking and distribution collapse.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building deep learning or RL systems — especially where strong results depended on environment design, reward engineering, training infrastructure, or rigorous evaluation.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and build RL environments and verifier systems

  • Work with customer researchers to translate RL training goals into environment specs: target capabilities, task distributions, difficulty curves, and success criteria.
  • Design task suites with verifiable outcomes — single-step and long-horizon workflows with clear ground-truth signals.

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Build AI-Powered Computer-Vision Products with Us


Our company specializes in AI-driven computer vision solutions for the wood industry, enhancing production efficiency and sustainability. Collaborating with the world's leading sawmills, we play a pivotal role in supporting the shift to a carbon-neutral future. Our focus is on innovation and technology, fostering automation to minimize waste.


We work in small, highly skilled teams that embody a startup-like mentality, embracing diverse cultures from Belgium, Romania, Spain, and Brazil. As a horizontal organization, we value initiative and self-drive. Our development team boasts members with over 15 years of experience, including key figures such as founding members and team leads who have successfully guided startups to exits exceeding 150 million dollars.


We're Looking for You!


Are you excited to learn and grow in a fast-paced tech environment? Do you want to work with experienced professionals who can mentor you? If yes, we'd love to have you join our team.


Your Role:


  • Work in an Agile environment with a team of experienced developers, researchers, and business analysts
  • Architect and develop highly performant software components, with an emphasis on scalability and robustness
  • Build back-end components for web-based applications built around the product
  • Actively participate with ideas for improving the product
  • Write automated tests and document your code
  • Participate in code review sessions
  • Engage in knowledge transfer and coaching sessions – you’ll have the opportunity to understand how the entire ecosystem works and contribute to components of the project which you might be interested in – AI, computer vision, HPC.
  • Work and innovate with R&D to integrate research results into the final product


What We Need from You:


Every Neural Grader team member is an important asset to us and makes their mark on the projects they’re working on. Here is what we’re looking for in this role:


  • Technical Bachelor's degree
  • Have a very high understanding of OOP concepts and comprehensive knowledge across programming fields
  • Self-driven and able to drive tasks to completion independently
  • Pragmatic and goal-oriented
  • Very good technical knowledge and work experience with Java, Spring Boot, JPA, SQL
  • Ability to architect complex features, focusing on performance
  • Image processing/computer vision skills are a plus


What We Offer


  • Flat structure—initiative beats hierarchy
  • Competitive salary
  • Training, coaching, and certifications
  • Periodic performance evaluations
  • Performance or special occasion bonuses
  • Remote work
  • Team buildings
  • Plus, a high-tech lab with industrial cameras and lasers


Ready to Apply?

We're excited to hear from you! Send us your application and let's start the conversation about your future with us.

title: Research Engineer, Multimodal
description:
The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Multimodal to help deliver frontier-quality multimodal datasets, evaluations, and RL environments that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.


This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their multimodal model improvement goals into concrete data specs — designing tasks that test genuine cross-modal reasoning, not just text comprehension with images attached.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building or improving multimodal AI systems — especially where strong results depended on data curation across modalities, evaluation design, or building systems that handle the complexity of real-world documents, charts, and visual interfaces.


What You'll Do

1. Design and deliver multimodal datasets and evaluation environments

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for multimodal capabilities: chart reading, document QA, UI understanding, diagram-based reasoning, OCR-aware tasks, and visual grounding.
  • Design task suites that test true multimodal reasoning — tasks where the answer requires integrating information across text, images, tables, and document structure, not just surface-level pattern matching.
  • Build ground-truth signals and verification systems for multimodal tasks, where correctness often depends on spatial relationships, visual context, and cross-reference between modalities.
  • Define task formats and data schemas that capture the full richness of multimodal inputs while remaining tractable for model training.


2. Build quality and validation systems for multimodal data

  • Perform deep audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors in visual grounding, incorrect chart readings, OCR artifacts, layout misinterpretations, and ambiguous visual references.
  • Implement automated validation: consistency checks across modalities, format and schema validation, deduplication, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic data generation pipelines: programmatic chart/table generation, document layout templating, controlled visual perturbations, and augmentation across visual conditions.

3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals targeting multimodal capabilities aligned with customer goals.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted multimodal tasks, error breakdowns by modality and task type, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable multimodal improvement.

4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, visual examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, domain SMEs, and data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in multimodal quality metrics.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale multimodal data creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for cross-modal correctness and realism.


Who We're Looking For

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of experience building or improving AI systems involving multimodal data — images, documents, charts, tables, or visual interfaces combined with text.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of: document understanding, chart/diagram reasoning, OCR systems, UI understanding, or vision-language models.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good multimodal task: genuine cross-modal reasoning requirements, clear ground truth, and resistance to text-only shortcuts.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented — you catch when a chart label is misread, a table cell is misaligned, or a visual reference is ambiguous.
  • Python proficiency required; comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning multimodal model goals into concrete data specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • RL or post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design applied to multimodal tasks.
  • Experience with vision-language models (CLIP, LLaVA, GPT-4V, Gemini, or equivalent).
  • Agentic evaluation involving visual grounding: browser-use agents, UI navigation, or screen-based task completion.
  • Experience building evaluation frameworks or benchmarks for multimodal systems.
  • Audio/video understanding experience (optional but valued).


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the multimodal datasets and evaluations training the next generation of vision-language models.
  • Real impact: your data will directly shape how models learn to read charts, understand documents, navigate interfaces, and reason across modalities.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

title: Gerente de produtos sênior
description:
A Listenx é líder em Music Branding na América latina.


Atuamos no modelo SAAS combinando tecnologia, música e anúncios no ponto de vendas para entregar comunicação estratégica e experiências musicais que fidelizam clientes e aumentam vendas.


Com soluções para todos os tamanhos de empresas, a Listenx está presente em mais de 16.000 clientes de todos os tamanhos no Brasil e América latina.


Somos apaixonados por música, tecnologia e inovação , crescemos em ritmo acelerado e estamos buscando pessoas para construir essa jornada junto com a gente.


✔️Sua missão:

Liderar a estratégia e a execução do produto, garantindo alinhamento entre visão de negócio, necessidades dos clientes e capacidade técnica.

Responsável por maximizar geração de valor, crescimento de receita recorrente, retenção e escalabilidade da plataforma SaaS, estruturando processos e promovendo cultura orientada a resultados.


✔️Responsabilidades:

• Definir e evoluir a estratégia de produto alinhada ao planejamento da empresa.

• Construir e gerir o roadmap com base em impacto, dados e validação com clientes.

• Liderar times de Produto, UX/UI e Engenharia com foco em performance e responsabilidade por resultados.

• Conduzir discovery contínuo para gerar crescimento, retenção e vantagem competitiva.

• Garantir entregas com qualidade, previsibilidade e foco em impacto, utilizando métodos ágeis.

• Monitorar e otimizar indicadores de produto e receita.

• Integrar Produto com Vendas, Marketing e Customer Success para crescimento sustentável.

• Estruturar governança, processos e rituais da área.

• Gerir orçamento e apoiar decisões estratégicas de investimento e alocação de recursos.


✔️Requisitos e Diferenciais:

• Experiência acima de 6 anos em cargos de gestão na área de produto, preferencialmente em empresas de tecnologia

• Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas.

• Experiência com definição de roadmap, discovery, product-market fit e escalabilidade de produto.

• Vivência comprovada na liderança de times técnicos e multidisciplinares.

• Sólidos conhecimentos técnicos para dialogar com Engenharia (arquitetura, APIs, integrações, cloud)

• Será um diferencial ter atuado no modelo de negócio de tecnologia (Saas)


✔️O que esperamos de você:

• Visão estratégica

• Tomada de decisão baseada em dados

• Comunicação clara e objetiva

• Capacidade analítica e orientação a métricas

• Trabalho em equipe


✔️Benefícios:

  • Vale Refeição
  • Vale Transporte ou Vale Combustível
  • Estacionamento
  • Ajuda de custo (Home Office)
  • Bônus Setup (Home Office)
  • Plano de Saúde
  • Plano Odontológico
  • Wellhub (Gympass)
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Descontos em Pós Graduação (FGV, FIAP, Mackenzie)
  • Inglês in company
  • Plataforma G4 Educação para conteúdos e cursos online


✔️Mais informações:

  • Horário de trabalho: Segunda à sexta (jornada flexível)
  • Modelo de contratação: CLT
  • Formato de trabalho: Híbrido (2 dias presenciais)
  • Local de trabalho: Bairro Ipiranga/SP (Em frente ao metrô)
  • Oferecemos todos os equipamentos para o home-office

title: Senior Full-Stack Mobile Engineer (React Native)
description:
This role requires deep, verified React Native experience. If your background is primarily React web, native iOS/Android, or backend-only, this is not the right fit.


FlyMeOut is a profitable, invite-only social travel network growing over 160% year-over-year. We run a highly selective social travel platform — and we're moving fast and expanding offerings in 2026.


We're not pre-revenue. We're not burning cash. We're growing, and we need a senior full-stack mobile engineer who can ship production React Native features on day one.


What you'll build: You'll lead development across our React Native mobile app (Expo, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Zustand) and work with our existing Node.js/TypeScript backend. The work is technically interesting — complex booking flows across yacht charters and villa rentals, payment orchestration with Stripe and Apple Pay, real-time features, and third-party API integrations. This isn't maintenance. You're shipping features that users interact with immediately.


Day to day, you'll be working on things like:

  • Designing and building new features end-to-end in React Native with TypeScript
  • Architecting booking and payment flows across multiple travel verticals
  • Integrating with payment platforms (Stripe, Apple Pay) and partner reservation APIs
  • Working with Firebase for auth, real-time data, and push notifications
  • Collaborating directly with the founder on product direction and technical decisions
  • Code reviews and mentoring a mid-level React Native engineer on the team


You should have:

  • 5+ years shipping production React Native apps (not React web — we will verify this)
  • Strong experience with Expo, TypeScript, and modern state management (TanStack Query, Zustand, or similar)
  • Backend capability with Node.js — you can work with and extend our existing API layer
  • Hands-on experience integrating third-party APIs, especially payment processors
  • Comfort working independently in a small team where you own the outcome


Nice to have:

  • Experience with travel tech, hospitality, or marketplace platforms
  • Familiarity with booking/reservation systems
  • Experience leading or mentoring other engineers
  • Apple Pay integration experience


Why FlyMeOut:

  • Profitable company with real revenue — not a cash-burning startup hoping for a runway extension
  • Growing 160%+ year-over-year with a planned fundraise in summer 2026
  • Fully remote — we hire across Latin America and work on overlapping timezones
  • Lean team, big ownership — your input directly shapes the product
  • Expanding into yacht charters, villa rentals, and restaurant reservations — you'd be building these from the ground up
  • Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction


Compensation & Terms

This is a full-time remote contractor position paid as a flat monthly rate via Wise.

Salary range: $60,000–$84,000/year ($5,000–$7,000/month)

Time off: 2 weeks PTO (flexible)

Health benefits: Not offered at this stage

Equity: Discussed on a case-by-case basis

Probation: 2 weeks

Core collaboration hours: 7:00 AM–2:00 PM PST | 12:00 PM–7:00 PM Brasil


How to Apply

Send your resume to with the subject line FMO-RN-2026 . In the body of your email, name one React Native app you have shipped that is currently live on the App Store or Google Play. Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.

title: Tech Lead
description:
A Teddy Open Finance está em busca de um profissional talentoso e motivado para se juntar à nossa equipe. Se você deseja fazer parte do futuro do setor financeiro, venha para o nosso time.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Liderar e orientar equipes de desenvolvedores, interagindo com múltiplas Squads para garantir o sucesso dos produtos/projetos;
  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter sistemas utilizando Nodejs e outras tecnologias relevantes;
  • Gerenciar sistemas de mensageria, incluindo Kafka ou RabbitMQ, para suportar processos de integração e entrega de dados;
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de arquitetura e design;
  • Garantir a qualidade do código e dos produtos;
  • Avaliar e otimizar o desempenho dos aplicativos e sistemas;
  • Apoiar na evolução da esteira DevOps;
  • Apoiar infra na gestão de custo da AWS;
  • Contribuir para planejamento de solução junto ao time de produto e design.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de software com Nodejs;
  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de aplicações em nuvem ambiente AWS;
  • Conhecimento em mensageria Kafka, RabbitMQ, Etc;
  • Experiência em git e gitflow;
  • Experiência em liderança de equipes;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de software em escala e Micro serviços;
  • Experiência em ambientes de DevOps;
  • Ter atuado em squads e métodos ágeis;
  • Conhecimento nas ferramentas da Atlassian como Jira e Confluence.


Diferenciais :

  • Conhecimento em Front End e em outras linguagens;
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados MySQL, PostGree, Redis, MongoDB.


Benefícios

  • Vale alimentação
  • Vale refeição
  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Alura
  • FIAP
  • Total Pass
  • Programa de orientação pessoal - C4 Life
  • Day Off

title: Senior Network Security Engineer
description:
The Network Security Engineer is responsible for protecting an organization’s networks and data from cyber threats. This role involves designing, implementing, and maintaining security infrastructure (firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, VPNs, etc.) and monitoring the network for vulnerabilities or incidents. The engineer will play a critical role in upholding Zero Trust security principles and ensuring high availability and integrity of network services in a dynamic, cloud-enabled environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Security Infrastructure Management: Configure, deploy, and maintain network security systems (firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN gateways, encryption devices) to safeguard internal networks and cloud environments.
  • Threat Monitoring & Incident Response: Monitor network traffic and logs for suspicious activities; promptly investigate and respond to security incidents or breaches to minimize impact.
  • Vulnerability Assessment: Conduct regular security audits, vulnerability scans, and penetration tests to identify and remediate network weaknesses. Implement patches and updates to address vulnerabilities and ensure systems are protected against emerging threats.
  • Access Control & Policies: Enforce access controls and network segmentation (supporting a Zero Trust Network Access model) by administering firewalls and network access control lists. Develop and update network security policies, standards, and procedures to align with best practices and compliance requirements.
  • Collaboration & Advisory: Work closely with IT infrastructure teams, application developers, and security architects to integrate security measures into new projects and systems. Provide guidance on secure network design and educate team members on security best practices.
  • Documentation & Compliance: Maintain detailed documentation of configurations, incidents, and changes. Ensure all network security measures comply with relevant regulations and industry standards (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS) and assist in preparing for security audits.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education & Background: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent work experience).
  • Technical Skills: Strong understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, etc.) and hands-on experience with network security technologies (firewalls such as Palo Alto/Cisco/Fortinet, IDS/IPS, VPN solutions, SIEM tools). Proficiency in configuring and managing firewalls and routing/switching equipment in complex networks.
  • Security Expertise: Knowledge of cybersecurity principles , threat landscape, and best practices (e.g., Zero Trust architecture, defense-in-depth, encryption, secure network design ). Ability to perform log analysis, intrusion detection, malware analysis basics, and incident handling.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for diagnosing network and security issues. Ability to respond effectively under pressure during security incidents or outages.
  • Communication & Teamwork: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders, and provide user training or guidance on security policies when needed.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced/Cloud Security: Experience with cloud security (AWS, Azure, or GCP networking and security services) or secure network design in hybrid cloud environments . Familiarity with SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) frameworks or software-defined networking is a plus.
  • Automation & Scripting: Scripting or automation skills (e.g., Python, PowerShell) to automate network/security tasks and improve efficiency in security operations.
  • Advanced Education: Master’s degree in Cybersecurity or Information Systems.

Experience Requirements:

  • Experience: Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in network security, cybersecurity engineering, or a related IT infrastructure security role. Proven track record implementing and managing firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPNs, and performing security monitoring and incident response in an enterprise or managed services environment.

Certifications:

  • Industry Certifications: Professional certifications are highly advantageous . Preferred certifications include CISSP, CISM (for security management knowledge) or CEH, GIAC (for technical security skills). Vendor-specific certifications such as Palo Alto Networks PCNSE/PCNSA are also valuable and demonstrate expertise in relevant technologies.

title: Senior Network Security Engineer
description:
The Network Security Engineer is responsible for protecting an organization’s networks and data from cyber threats. This role involves designing, implementing, and maintaining security infrastructure (firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, VPNs, etc.) and monitoring the network for vulnerabilities or incidents. The engineer will play a critical role in upholding Zero Trust security principles and ensuring high availability and integrity of network services in a dynamic, cloud-enabled environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Security Infrastructure Management: Configure, deploy, and maintain network security systems (firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN gateways, encryption devices) to safeguard internal networks and cloud environments.
  • Threat Monitoring & Incident Response: Monitor network traffic and logs for suspicious activities; promptly investigate and respond to security incidents or breaches to minimize impact.
  • Vulnerability Assessment: Conduct regular security audits, vulnerability scans, and penetration tests to identify and remediate network weaknesses. Implement patches and updates to address vulnerabilities and ensure systems are protected against emerging threats.
  • Access Control & Policies: Enforce access controls and network segmentation (supporting a Zero Trust Network Access model) by administering firewalls and network access control lists. Develop and update network security policies, standards, and procedures to align with best practices and compliance requirements.
  • Collaboration & Advisory: Work closely with IT infrastructure teams, application developers, and security architects to integrate security measures into new projects and systems. Provide guidance on secure network design and educate team members on security best practices.
  • Documentation & Compliance: Maintain detailed documentation of configurations, incidents, and changes. Ensure all network security measures comply with relevant regulations and industry standards (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS) and assist in preparing for security audits.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education & Background: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent work experience).
  • Technical Skills: Strong understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, etc.) and hands-on experience with network security technologies (firewalls such as Palo Alto/Cisco/Fortinet, IDS/IPS, VPN solutions, SIEM tools). Proficiency in configuring and managing firewalls and routing/switching equipment in complex networks.
  • Security Expertise: Knowledge of cybersecurity principles , threat landscape, and best practices (e.g., Zero Trust architecture, defense-in-depth, encryption, secure network design ). Ability to perform log analysis, intrusion detection, malware analysis basics, and incident handling.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for diagnosing network and security issues. Ability to respond effectively under pressure during security incidents or outages.
  • Communication & Teamwork: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders, and provide user training or guidance on security policies when needed.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced/Cloud Security: Experience with cloud security (AWS, Azure, or GCP networking and security services) or secure network design in hybrid cloud environments . Familiarity with SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) frameworks or software-defined networking is a plus.
  • Automation & Scripting: Scripting or automation skills (e.g., Python, PowerShell) to automate network/security tasks and improve efficiency in security operations.
  • Advanced Education: Master’s degree in Cybersecurity or Information Systems.

Experience Requirements:

  • Experience: Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in network security, cybersecurity engineering, or a related IT infrastructure security role. Proven track record implementing and managing firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPNs, and performing security monitoring and incident response in an enterprise or managed services environment.

title: Product Owner Pleno (PO)
description:
Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?


Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um(a) Super Product Owner Pleno , que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de Produtos e que queria crescer (muito!) com a gente.


Responsabilidades:

Estratégia e visão de produto

  • Contribuir para a definição da visão do produto e alinhamento com stakeholders;
  • Identificar problemas relevantes e oportunidades de melhoria baseadas em dados e feedback de usuários;
  • Priorizar iniciativas alinhadas aos OKRs trimestrais.


Discovery e validação de soluções

  • Conduzir discovery contínuo para entendimento profundo de problemas e necessidades;
  • Criar e validar hipóteses de solução antes da implementação em escala;
  • Construir ou apoiar a construção de MVPs rápidos utilizando ferramentas de IA, prototipação e low-code;
  • Testar soluções com usuários antes de direcionar o time de engenharia.


Gestão do produto e delivery

  • Criar épicos e histórias de usuário bem estruturadas, com critérios de aceite claros;
  • Gerir backlog upstream e downstream;
  • Priorizar e refinar demandas com o time de tecnologia;
  • Orientar o time sobre regras de negócio e objetivos das entregas;
  • Avaliar e aceitar entregas garantindo aderência aos critérios definidos.


Colaboração com o time

  • Trabalhar próximo aos times de UX, Engenharia e Dados;
  • Participar de rituais do time (dailys, refinamentos, planning e retrospectivas);
  • Garantir clareza de contexto e objetivos para o time multidisciplinar.


Gestão por dados

  • Monitorar métricas de produto e comportamento do usuário;
  • Utilizar dados para validar hipóteses e apoiar decisões de produto;
  • Conduzir experimentos (A/B tests, testes de solução, validações rápidas).


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida atuando como Product Manager ou Product Owner;
  • Forte habilidade de priorização de backlog;
  • Experiência com Discovery e Delivery de produto;
  • Capacidade de estruturar histórias de usuário, critérios de aceite e cenários;
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis como Scrum e Kanban;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de produto (Jira, Miro ou similares);
  • Experiência com análise de dados de produto (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Google Analytics, HubSpot ou similares);
  • Experiência com testes e experimentação em produtos digitais;
  • Experiência com métricas de produto digital.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em estatística ou ciência de dados;
  • Noções de arquitetura e stacks de tecnologia (backend, web, app, infraestrutura);
  • Experiência em varejo, e-commerce ou marketplaces;
  • Experiência em startups;
  • Experiência com prototipação rápida e ferramentas de construção low-code / IA.


O que esperamos dessa pessoa:

  • Forte orientação a resolver problemas reais dos usuários ;
  • Mentalidade data-driven ;
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões com autonomia e responsabilidade ;
  • Perfil mão na massa , confortável em testar soluções rapidamente;
  • Curiosidade e abertura para trabalhar com IA e novas ferramentas de construção de produto ;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de colaboração com times multidisciplinares.


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?

  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.



O que oferecemos:

title: Senior Carrier Business Development Executive
description:
China Mobile International Limited (CMI) is a wholly-owned subsidiary of China Mobile. In order to provide better services to meet the growing demand in the international telecommunications market, China Mobile established CMI in December 2010, headquartered in Hong Kong, China. CMI has expanded its footprint in 39 countries and regions.

Leveraging the strong support by China Mobile, CMI is a trusted partner that provides comprehensive international information services and solutions to international enterprises, carriers and mobile users.


We are looking for a dynamic and proactive Senior Carrier Business Development Executive to join our team.


This role is responsible for driving business growth through new customer acquisition, account management, and strategic carrier partnerships across Voice, A2P messaging, and eSIM mobility products. The position plays a critical role in expanding market penetration, optimizing commercial conditions, and ensuring smooth operational execution in close collaboration with internal, regional, and HQ teams.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Establish, develop, and expand business relationships with customers and partners across Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility products, driving new revenue opportunities and account growth.
  • Define and execute sales and business development strategies, managing a structured sales pipeline by customer account and region to achieve revenue and market penetration targets.
  • Manage customer accounts end to end, including commercial negotiations, daily operational follow-up, service performance review, and after-sales support.
  • Develop and manage strategic relationships with global Voice, A2P, and mobile carriers, leading negotiations to secure competitive pricing, routing, capacity, and commercial terms.
  • Lead carrier and customer contract execution, including onboarding, implementation, performance monitoring, and renewals.
  • Monitor market trends, customer needs, and carrier performance to identify growth, optimization, and partnership opportunities.
  • Support the optimization of Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility supply networks, ensuring service continuity, cost efficiency, and scalability.
  • Work closely with internal commercial, technical, and operational teams to ensure smooth end-to-end execution from opportunity identification to service activation.
  • Collaborate with HQ and regional teams to align on sales targets, partnership strategies, and overall business performance.
  • Analyze commercial and operational performance and prepare sales and performance reports for management review.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Solid telecommunications experience in the LATAM market.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory.


Preferred Requirements:

  • Advanced to fluent proficiency in Spanish or Mandarin Chinese.

title: Data Engineer Powercenter (Realocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • +3years of experience as a Data Engineer with Informatica PowerCenter .
  • Strong knowledge of ETL processes and development of complex workflows and data pipelines.
  • Experience with Informatica Cloud / CDI-PC / IICS , including design, implementation, and maintenance of cloud data integration pipelines .
  • Experience in developing integrated solutions and creating complex workflows in a corporate data environment.
  • Ability to plan, monitor, and deliver projects within timelines and budget.
  • Experience in testing, data quality, and defect management.
  • Good command of English.
  • Willingness to relocate to Portugal (Porto or Lisbon); eligible for a Portuguese work visa or holding EU/dual nationality.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote based in Portugal/on-site.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Dental Insurance Posting Agent
description:
If you thrive on accuracy, move with urgency, and take pride in making sure every dollar is posted correctly and every discrepancy is resolved, this role was made for you.


As a Dental Insurance Posting Agent, you’ll be at the core of our revenue cycle operations. You’ll ensure that every insurance payment, adjustment, and denial is posted accurately and reconciled promptly, helping protect the financial health of our organization while supporting a smooth experience for patients and providers. Every payment you apply, every discrepancy you investigate, and every balance you resolve directly impacts cash flow, reporting accuracy, and overall client satisfaction.


About iCore


iCore is a dentist-led healthcare company with more than 15 years of experience supporting dental and healthcare practices nationwide. We combine secure, cloud-based technology with hands-on practice management services to help practices run stronger clinical and administrative operations.

We are more than a software company. iCoreConnect partners directly with practices to support revenue cycle management, billing, insurance verification, compliance, analytics, and day-to-day operational workflows. Our approach is built on real-world experience and a deep understanding of how practices actually function.

title: UX Designer - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: Ux Design - Remoto


O que oferecemos a você:

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas

- Auxílio creche

- Seguro de vida

- Parceria com instituições de ensino

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

Projeto de desenvolvimento e melhorias em sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência com UX Research e testes de usabilidade
  • Experiência em UI/UX Design (fluxos, jornadas e arquitetura da informação)
  • Domínio de Figma
  • Vivência com discovery de produto
  • Conhecimento em Design System, Design Thinking e Lean Inception
  • Experiência com métricas de UX/Produto


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail .

title: Software Engineer
description:
Exciting Career Opportunity: Software Engineer - Quality & AI Infrastructure

Location: Remote

Salary: $30K-$60K per year


Most of your time will be spent making our existing software more reliable. You'll dig into production bugs, trace them to root cause, and write the tests that should have caught them. You'll review pull requests in a way that raises the bar without demoralizing anyone. You'll tackle the tech debt that everyone complains about in retros but nobody picks up.


The other part — and this is growing — is our AI agent work. We're building tooling, orchestration, and evaluation systems for LLM-powered features. This isn't a research project. It's production software that needs the same rigor as everything else we ship. We need someone who can bring that rigor.


What you'll do

  • Debug and fix issues across the stack, from staging through production
  • Build meaningful test coverage (the kind that actually catches regressions)
  • Review code thoroughly — with context, not just style nits
  • Refactor the parts of the codebase that slow the team down
  • Help define how we ship: observability, release process, quality gates
  • Work with product and design to land features cleanly
  • Contribute to our AI agent infrastructure: tool-calling, orchestration, evaluation, safety


What we're looking for

  • 4-6 years of professional software engineering experience
  • Real debugging experience in distributed systems — you've traced issues across services, not just stepped through a single process
  • A habit of writing tests, ideally born from experience rather than mandate
  • Thoughtful code review skills — you give feedback people learn from
  • Comfort working in an existing codebase you didn't write
  • Working understanding of LLM basics: prompting, context windows, hallucination, evaluation
  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical teammates


Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with AI agents, tool-calling, or workflow orchestration
  • Familiarity with RAG, embeddings, vector databases, or model eval pipelines
  • Observability chops (logs, metrics, tracing, incident response)
  • CI/CD experience and opinions about what belongs in a quality gate
  • A history of writing internal documentation that people actually reference


Apply Here: careers.hirebus.com/jobs/c052c69b-d3ac-441f-9455-6c672d90dd45
