title: OPERADOR DE CALDEIRA
description:
Na Agropalma, há muita coisa boa à sua espera. Então, se você é um profissional apaixonado por aprendizado e gosta de trabalhar em união, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Juntos, alcançaremos nossos objetivos.


Estamos com oportunidades para pessoas com deficiência para todo o grupo.


Descrição Breve do Cargo :

Operar caldeiras, efetuar a dosagem de produtos químicos nas caldeiras, monitorar o descarregamento de BPF de carretas para tanques, realizar manobras de descarregamento de óleo diesel, operar estação de tratamento de agua, realizar a movimentação de insumos para a Refinaria, operar plantas de branqueamento e desodorização, executar suas atividades conforme rotinas operacionais, atuar, sempre que necessário, nas áreas de carregamento e formulação e na Estação de Tratamento de Efluentes, executar outras atividades correlatas conforme orientação superior.



Requisitos:

  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Segurança na Operação de Vasos de Pressão - NR 13.
  • Flexibilidade de aprendizagem.
  • Experiência como operador de Caldeira ou de Produção.
  • Interesse em aprender sobre processos industriais.
  • Informática básica/intermediária.


Nossa Empresa

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. Atualmente, a companhia conta com seis indústrias de extração de óleo bruto, duas refinarias e um terminal de exportação alfandegado, e emprega cerca de 5 mil colaboradores. A Agropalma também foi pioneira em implementar, há mais de 20 anos, um programa de Agricultura Familiar com palma, que beneficia hoje mais de 300 agricultores parceiros. Guiada pelo compromisso com o planeta e as pessoas, a empresa segue avançando em suas práticas para tornar a palma sustentável uma referência brasileira. Para mais informações, acesse:


#VemSerAgropalma

title: Desenvolvedor(a) SAP BTP CAP
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


A transformação digital ajuda as empresas a atingirem seu potencial máximo - se as tecnologias funcionarem para as pessoas que as utilizam! A NTT DATA Business Solutions está há 30 anos no mercado mundial. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por transformação. E queremos transformar o mundo e as pessoas através das soluções que criamos juntos com nossos parceiros. Aqui projetamos, implementamos, gerenciamos e potencializamos continuamente as soluções SAP para fazê-las funcionar para as empresas – e para as pessoas.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Buscamos um(a) profissional SAP FullStack (Pleno ou Sênior) para atuar em ambientes SAP S/4HANA, com foco em desenvolvimento moderno utilizando o modelo RAP e aplicações Fiori. A posição envolve atuação ponta a ponta, desde a camada de dados e serviços até a interface, colaborando com arquitetos e consultores funcionais em times ágeis ou híbridos.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver soluções SAP FullStack no ambiente S/4HANA.
  • Implementar serviços utilizando o modelo RAP (RESTful ABAP Programming Model).
  • Criar e manter CDS Views (projection, exposure e behavior) e Behavior Definitions.
  • Desenvolver Service Definitions e Service Bindings com exposição via OData V4.
  • Construir aplicações com Fiori Elements.
  • Atuar com ABAP OO seguindo boas práticas de Clean Code e qualidade de código.
  • Realizar revisões de código e aplicar padrões de qualidade e sustentabilidade técnica.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com arquitetos, consultores funcionais e times ágeis.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência prática com SAP S/4HANA.
  • Domínio do modelo RAP.
  • Conhecimento sólido em ABAP Orientado a Objetos.
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de atuação em times ágeis ou híbridos.
  • Mentalidade orientada a Clean Code, qualidade e manutenção evolutiva.


Diferenciais (Desejável):


  • Participação em pelo menos uma implementação greenfield de SAP S/4HANA.
  • Experiência com ATC, SCI ou outras ferramentas de qualidade de código.
  • Certificações SAP.
  • Inglês intermediário/ avançado.


Regime de contratação: CLT

100% Remoto no Brasil

Viagens pontoais (2-3 vezes ao ano)


Liberte todo o seu potencial e engenhosidade – molde o seu próprio futuro. Somos mais do que apenas um local de trabalho; somos uma incubadora de talentos. Com diversos caminhos e oportunidades de aprendizado e carreira de longo prazo, oferecemos inúmeras maneiras de realizar seus sonhos.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Sr. Procurement Analyst -80% Spanish
description:
About the Job


Sr. Procurement Analyst will execute and manage Indirect spend categories' strategic sourcing and procurement across all supply chain operations facility types agreed to be in-scope and will deliver business requirements providing the best value to key business stakeholders.The focus will be managing the end-to-end strategic sourcing process and all in-scope elements of indirect spend for LATAM with emphasis on Brazil and the rest of the countries of South America (not limited).


Scope: Regions: Americas (subregion: LATAM)


Languages : Portuguese and Spanish 90%


Key Responsibilities May Include:


  • Develop and execute category strategies aligned with regional and global procurement priorities, leveraging market analysis to optimize supplier selection and performance.
  • Lead end-to-end sourcing activities, including negotiating contracts, managing supplier relationships, and ensuring compliance with company policies and legal requirements.
  • Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities within assigned categories to meet annual savings targets and drive value for the business.
  • Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders to align procurement activities with business needs and ensure early involvement in the sourcing process.
  • Monitor supplier performance against key performance indicators (KPIs) and address gaps to improve quality, delivery, and cost efficiency.
  • Ensure procurement activities adhere to governance, ethical sourcing practices, and sustainability objectives while supporting audit and compliance requirements.
  • Provide regular reporting and analytics on procurement performance, including spend analysis, cost savings, and supplier performance metrics.
  • Collaborate with global category managers and cross-functional teams to leverage scale, align strategies, and drive procurement initiatives effectively.



Experience- What you will bring


  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred (Business, Supply Chain, or Engineering).
  • Operations support experience.
  • 4+ years of procurement experience supporting business operations with YoY savings.
  • Strong supplier segmentation, supplier performance and relationship management
  • experience
  • Experience in business operations, or supporting operations, at a large
  • multinational company.
  • Strategic Sourcing knowledge and experience (7-Step Process).
  • Procurement/Purchasing Experience +5 years
  • Contract negotiations.
  • Customer service minded.



Skills & Knowledge

Strong Negotiation and commercial contracting skills specially in professional services,

facilities and maintenance (MRO).

• Use of computer tools such as Microsoft Excel, Coupa, CLMs.

• Knowledge of plant operations preferred.

• This role demands continuous interaction with key stakeholders within Brambles Supply

Chain and Corporate Business.

• Data Analytics (Intermediate level Excel to include Pivot tables, formulas, etc.) with

development potential.

title: Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML - Inbound Team)
description:
Senior Applied Scientist – AI/ML Customer Science (Remote – Brazil)


Location: 100% Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ – Long term


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to design, develop, and deploy advanced machine learning, causal inference, and optimization systems that drive Marketing and Sales decision-making.

In this role, you will transform complex customer behavior and business growth challenges into measurable objectives and scalable ML solutions across acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue optimization.

You will work at the intersection of machine learning, experimentation, causal inference, and business strategy in a fast-paced, collaborative, and entrepreneurial environment.


What You’ll Work On

You will build models and platforms that create impact across areas such as:

  • Sales prioritization and expected value modeling
  • Marketing targeting and uplift modeling
  • Multi-touch attribution and incrementality measurement
  • Customer lifecycle modeling (conversion, retention, churn, LTV)
  • Outreach optimization and personalization systems


Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop machine learning, statistical, and causal models for Marketing and Sales use cases including:
  • Propensity and expected value modeling
  • Uplift and treatment effect estimation
  • Attribution and marketing measurement
  • Forecasting, optimization, and prioritization systems
  • Translate business growth problems into clear objectives, loss functions, and evaluation frameworks
  • Design feature representations capturing customer behavior, engagement, and lifecycle dynamics
  • Design and analyze experiments (A/B tests, geo tests, incrementality tests, diff-in-diff, causal impact)
  • Build and maintain robust evaluation frameworks aligned with business outcomes (ROI, CAC, conversion, retention, LTV)
  • Own the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring
  • Develop scalable ML services integrated into business workflows (CRM, marketing platforms, internal tools)
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Data teams
  • Influence technical direction and roadmap prioritization based on business impact
  • Clearly communicate insights and model behavior to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers and help establish best practices
  • Contribute to long-term data science strategy, platforms, and innovation


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML models in production at scale
  • Strong knowledge of ML best practices (feature engineering, experimentation, pipelines, model evaluation)
  • Experience with modern ML techniques including gradient boosting, deep learning, transformers, and optimization
  • Experience in Computer Vision (Causal Inference experience is a strong plus)
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with big data tools such as Apache Beam, Kafka, Spark
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)


Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • Experience applying ML in retail or commercial business contexts
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and production pipelines
  • Strong leadership and mentoring experience
  • Impact-driven mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality, scalable solutions

title: Freight Desk Manager
description:
Position Scope

The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region . This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities

  • Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding.
  • Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers.
  • Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency.
  • Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards.
  • Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments.
  • Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes.
  • Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency.
  • Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments.
  • Regional Expertise: Deep knowledge of the LATAM logistics landscape , including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks.
  • Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes.
  • Network Management: Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and \"Control Tower\" operational models.
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments.
  • Leadership: Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field.
  • Languages: Fluency in English is essential for regional and global coordination.

Desirable Requirements

  • Advanced Education: MBA or Master’s degree.
  • Process Excellence: Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience.
  • Digital Transformation: Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools.
  • Rapid Growth Background: Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.g., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

title: Analista de sistemas sênior
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
**Please Read*

Duration: This is expected to be a 12 month engagement, potential for extensions

Location : Remote in Brazil

Notice Period: 3 weeks

Structure: CLT - this CANNOT be adjusted.

Pay: R$15,268 to R$20,000 monthly

Senior AI Back-End Engineer

Must Haves:

  • 1+ years of experience as an AI/ML Engineer
  • 2+ years of Python development experience, including API creation, model training, testing, and general backend programming
  • Familiarity with LangChain for building LLM workflows using tools, memory, and retrieval.
  • Strong communication skills – able to work independently while providing clear updates to the team

Plusses:

  • Familiarity with AWS infrastructure (IAM, VPC, S3, etc.)
  • Experience with OpenSearch
  • Experience with Airflow and understanding of data orchestration
  • Exposure to RAG architectures, especially visual RAG use cases

Day-to-Day:

We are hiring two AI/LLM Engineers (1 Mid-Level, 1 Senior) to join a small, focused team building backend features for an existing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) service. You'll work on extracting structured data from diverse content types—images, graphs, eBooks, journals, and more—using visual-based models. This role involves experimentation, model development, and comparing LLMs for visual RAG use cases. You’ll deploy code to non-prod environments and support production rollout in collaboration with the DevOps team. While primarily a heads-down, individual contributor role, clear communication and collaboration with the team is expected.

title: Application Support Engineer (DevOPS | Data Product Support | Brazil)
description:
Company Description


Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm with a global footprint, bringing together diverse talents from various backgrounds to deliver innovative solutions to clients worldwide. We are committed to excellence, collaboration, and consistently exceeding performance expectations across a wide range of industries.


Mission Description


We are looking for an Application Support Engineer to establish and drive operational support for Data Products within a complex, data-driven environment at world’s leading investment bank as our customer.

You will play a key role in incident management, system stability, and knowledge transfer, while working closely with global teams across the globe. The role combines production support, data analysis, and light development to ensure high availability and performance of critical data services.


What you’ll do


Core Responsibilities

  • Provide L2/L3 application support for Data applications
  • Manage incident resolution and service restoration in production environments
  • Perform log analysis, debugging, and root cause investigations
  • Monitor and support data pipelines and data processing workflows
  • Execute and optimize SQL queries (Snowflake and other DBs)
  • Work with Unix/Linux environments for file, process, and system operations
  • Support AWS-based services (e.g., EC2, S3, Lambda)
  • Collaborate with global teams during operational hours

Additional Responsibilities

  • Create and maintain runbooks and support documentation
  • Support knowledge transfer activities from vendors or internal teams
  • Contribute to automation and development tasks (Python / Java scripting)
  • Assist in testing and stabilization phases of new product releases

Profile Requirements


Mandatory

  • 3+ years in Application Support / Production Support / Data Support roles
  • Strong SQL skills (Snowflake preferred)
  • Experience with Python or Java (scripting, automation, or support tooling)
  • Solid understanding of incident management (ITIL processes)
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • Unix/Linux environments (CLI, file/process management)
  • Log analysis & troubleshooting
  • Good communication skills and fluent English


Nice to have

  • Exposure to ETL pipelines / data integration workflows
  • Experience with AWS cloud services
  • Background in banking or financial sector or financial data / market data environments
  • Familiarity with:
  • Alloy
  • VLF-based query languages / Slang
  • Experience in high-availability environments


What We Offer?

  • A modern, dynamic, and future-oriented environment within a top global institution
  • Flexible working arrangements – fully remote or hybrid options
  • Continuous learning and certification opportunities
  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Long-term career prospects with international exposure
  • Inclusive, multicultural team with regular knowledge-sharing and team events

title: Wordpress Plugin & Full Stack Developer
description:
Please only apply if you are familiar with Wordpress Plugin Development, with strong PHP skills in additional to being a full stack (front and back) developer. Ideally you should also be comfortable with mobile apps and figuring out and doing different things in tech and thrive in a fast-paced fluid environment.


Do you love technology puzzles and figuring out how to make a variety of things to work? Are you great at catching mistakes through user testing for quality assurance? Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong problem solving skills? Do you have experience working with numerous different technology platforms in digital form, ranging from CRMs (like Constant Contact, Aweber, Beehiiv), Hosting (AWS, WHM), DNS (Cloudflare), Automtions (like zapier, make.com), project management (like jira.com)?


Detail oriented test and php / elementor test REQUIRED before video interview.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies in the United States stock market and other large scale projects. We started in 2019. We internally own 10 newsletter brands, a mobile app, and other digital assets.


Responsibilities

  • Focus on building out custom wordpress plugins for internal agency needs
  • Focus on connecting marketing data for purposes of analysis, can range from open rates in crm, to costs on paid media platforms, to click through data on sms provider.
  • Setting up CRM lists, automations, and funnels from start to finish with script, reporting and directly on the platforms.
  • Willing to have a flexible set of responsibilities to service whatever is required in daily operations, including posting daily new article first thing in the mornings.
  • Work hand-in-hand with CTO and CMO on various directives. If you see a way to do it better, we'd love to hear it.
  • Handle multiple projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by CTO or CMO.
  • Doing or setting up manual/automated reporting related to adspend, subscriber counts, open rates, cost per lead, etc
  • Copying, testing, and fixing Elementor landing pages and ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS, webhooks, etc.
  • Copying, testing, fixing PHP scripts ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS provider, webhooks, postbacks, etc.
  • On CRM set up lists/segments, automations for the welcome emails, templates, list cleaning,
  • Doing specific weekly and monthly audits of our 10 newsletter landing page and script funnels.
  • Testing and helping manage our mobile app.
  • Test Planning and Execution:  Design and implement test plans, scenarios, and procedures to test software functionality. 
  • Defect Management:  Identify, document, and track software defects (that you can't fix), then work with developers to ensure they are corrected before release
  • Collaboration:  Communicate and collaborate with developers, product managers, and other team members to understand requirements and provide feedback on usability and functionality. 
  • Automation:  Code and implement automated test scripts using various tools and frameworks. 
  • Quality Standards:  Create and enforce guidelines for software quality standards within the company. 


Qualifications

  • Proficient in Wordpress, Elementor, PHP, HTML/CSS
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, problem solving skills
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have the ability to multitask, in a VERY fast paced work environment.
  • This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.


Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level


To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • If selected, you'll receive invite to a couple skills test before video interview


Requirements Before Employment

  • Signed Confidentiality agreement
  • Signed Non-compete agreement
  • Signed Contract & W-8 BEN tax form


Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.
  • We're very loyal, focused, dedicated and hard-working.
  • Hours 8AM - 5PM, Mon-Fri, with certain US holidays included

title: Arquiteto de nuvem
description:
O Cloud Architect será responsável por conduzir avaliações técnicas, definir estratégias de migração, criar arquiteturas alvo e liderar a execução do plano proposto. Atuará como referência técnica para o time, garantindo alinhamento com padrões de arquitetura, governança e boas práticas da AWS.


Responsabilidades Principais:

-Realizar assessment dos ambientes atuais (discovery, análise de workloads, recomendações).

-Elaborar diagramas de arquitetura, planos de migração e cronogramas detalhados.

-Definir estratégias de migração considerando segurança, performance e custo.

-Apoiar na execução do plano de migração (delivery), garantindo aderência às recomendações.

-Utilizar ferramentas de apoio à migração (ex.: RV Tools, AWS Migration Evaluator, entre outras).

-Implementar práticas de monitoramento e otimização de performance pós-migração.

-Garantir conformidade com boas práticas da AWS e padrões corporativos.

-Interagir com stakeholders e apresentar relatórios técnicos.


Competências Técnicas:

-Experiência comprovada em projetos de migração para AWS Cloud (assessment e delivery).

-Conhecimento avançado em arquitetura de soluções AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, IAM, etc.).

-Familiaridade com ambientes on-premises (virtualização, redes, storage).

-Domínio de ferramentas de migração e discovery (ex: RV Tools, AWS Migration Evaluator, AWS Application Migration Service).

-Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento de performance (CloudWatch, Dynatrace, etc.).

-Capacidade de criar diagramas técnicos (Visio, Draw.io, Lucidchart).

-Inglês fluente.


Perfil comportamental:

-Pensamento analítico e visão estratégica.

-Proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma.

-Comunicação clara e habilidade para interagir com diferentes níveis hierárquicos.

-Orientação para resultados e foco em qualidade.

-Flexibilidade para lidar com ambientes complexos e mudanças de escopo.

title: Software Engineer Sênior - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas LGBTQIAPN+
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes.   • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.

  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).

  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)

  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender

title: Technical Lead
description:
Project Description:

  • The Anaplan Technical Lead is an experienced multi-skilled professional with hands-on experience in Anaplan model development/Support experience. He/she is a good team player who is part of a team responsible for delivering end-to-end application development and Operations Support.


Responsibilities:

  • • Troubleshoot and provide solutions, Root Cause Analysis for incidents raised by business users/L1 team.
  • • Troubleshoot issues related to application access, process, scripts, etc.
  • • Handles Anaplan planned downtimes individually.
  • • In case of incident with a product quality issue, ensure PR is created and tagged against the incident before closing it.
  • • Perform UAT testing for projects owned by operations like new market adoption, simple logic change, etc.
  • • Prepare, present changes in change advisory board and own production implementation.
  • • Coordinate and manage discussions with other support teams and business users.
  • • Effectively communicate with stakeholders and business users.
  • • Think creatively to solve the user problem with a holistic and simple solution.
  • • Drive best practices within teams with respect to operations standards and guidelines.
  • • Ability to learn and adapt to new frameworks/technologies.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • • Should have strong knowledge of Anaplan Connect, ALM Sync, NUX and Cloudworks.
  • • Anaplan Professional Model Builder / Professional Solution Architect Certified.
  • • Should have strong knowledge of troubleshooting and resolving incidents raised by business users and L1 Support.
  • • Good knowledge of troubleshooting and fixing job execution failures.
  • • Ability to analyse /root cause the PRs created for the Anaplan support models.
  • • Prior work experience in Anaplan Support projects.
  • Availability to work in US Central Time
  • Availability to regularly travel to St. Louis
  • • Good communication skills.


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

  • • Basic knowledge of Cloud Services
  • • Knowledge in SRE, ITIL, AgileOps
  • • Able to work independently and interact with the business community, L3 team to come up with solutions.
  • • Knowledge of testing tools like Playwright / Selenium.

title: Editorial Graphic Designer (Interiors + Spaces)
description:
So… who the heck is Residence Supply?


I'm Jacky, the founder. We started as a local lighting brand obsessed with historical architecture and heirloom craftsmanship. In just a few years we blew past 8 figures, launched hundreds of handcrafted SKUs, and built a cult following of design-obsessed homeowners. Our fixtures live in Architectural Digest–worthy homes.


Now we're building the ULTIMATE creative team. One that takes us from \"fastest-growing DTC brand\" to category-defining design house. We need a graphic designer who doesn't just execute... but one who sees the world the way our customers do. Through the lens of beauty, heritage, and taste.


What You'll Do

  • Design editorial ads that feel like they were pulled from a print magazine
  • Translate interior design trends and RS products into visual stories that stop the scroll
  • Build mood boards and visual direction decks to guide campaigns
  • Maintain and elevate brand visual consistency across every creative touchpoint
  • Collaborate with our Creative Strategist, Content team, and Founder on campaign ideation
  • QC all outgoing creative. Nothing ships unless it looks like Residence Supply


Who You Are

  • 3+ years designing for high-end lifestyle, interiors, fashion, or luxury DTC brands
  • Your portfolio looks like a coffee table book, not a social media dump
  • Obsessed with typography, white space, negative space, and editorial composition
  • You follow interior designers, architects, and design publications
  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
  • You understand the difference between beautiful and effective
  • Architecture or interior design background? You're already shortlisted.


What We're Building

Residence Supply is not trying to be another ecommerce brand. We're becoming a heritage-driven design house growing 100% year over year. This role will define the visual language that new customers judge us by. Your work will live in catalogs, on Pinterest boards of people building their dream homes, and in the feeds of the most design-literate buyers in the country.


This is your chance to join a founding creative team before the rocket takes off.


What We're Offering

  • Competitive Salary
  • 10 days PTO per year
  • Opportunity to grow into creative strategist/lead graphic designer
  • Fully remote


How to Apply

Don't send us a generic application. Send us:

  • A portfolio or 3–5 pieces you're most proud of... especially anything editorial, catalog, or interiors-adjacent please!
  • A quick paragraph on how you'd approach the visual feel of a Residence Supply print catalog
  • Tell us: what brand's visual identity do you wish you had built and why?


If the interview goes well, we hire on the call. Good luck.

  • Translate interior design trends and RS products into visual stories that stop the scroll
  • Build mood boards and visual direction decks to guide campaigns
  • Maintain and elevate brand visual consistency across every creative touchpoint
  • Collaborate with our Creative Strategist, Content team, and Founder on campaign ideation
  • QC all outgoing creative. Nothing ships unless it looks like Residence Supply


Who You Are

  • 3+ years designing for high-end lifestyle, interiors, fashion, or luxury DTC brands
  • Your portfolio looks like a coffee table book, not a social media dump
  • Obsessed with typography, white space, negative space, and editorial composition
  • You follow interior designers, architects, and design publications
  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
  • You understand the difference between beautiful and effective
  • Architecture or interior design background? You're already shortlisted.


What We're Building

Residence Supply is not trying to be another ecommerce brand. We're becoming a heritage-driven design house growing 100% year over year. This role will define the visual language that new customers judge us by. Your work will live in catalogs, on Pinterest boards of people building their dream homes, and in the feeds of the most design-literate buyers in the country.


This is your chance to join a founding creative team before the rocket takes off.


What We're Offering

  • Competitive Salary
  • 10 days PTO per year
  • Opportunity to grow into creative strategist/lead graphic designer
  • Fully remote


How to Apply

Don't send us a generic application. Send us:

  • A portfolio or 3–5 pieces you're most proud of... especially anything editorial, catalog, or interiors-adjacent please!
  • A quick paragraph on how you'd approach the visual feel of a Residence Supply print catalog
  • Tell us: what brand's visual identity do you wish you had built and why?


If the interview goes well, we hire on the call. Good luck.

title: UI Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle, from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

The UI Designer is a key contributor to Lilo Social's conversion rate optimization practice, responsible for designing high-performing Shopify storefronts and direct-response landing pages for a portfolio of 8- and 9-figure DTC brands. This role sits at the intersection of aesthetics and performance, translating CRO strategy, A/B test hypotheses, and brand guidelines into polished, conversion-optimized digital experiences. You will work closely with CRO strategists, developers, and client partners to bring designs from concept to implementation with precision and speed.


What Success Looks Like

  • Measurable improvements in CVR, AOV, and on-site engagement metrics across your client portfolio
  • High-quality design deliverables that are executed on-brief, on-brand, and on deadline
  • A consistent output of test-ready page variations that support an active A/B testing roadmap
  • Strong cross-functional relationships with CRO strategists and developers that accelerate design-to-launch velocity


Responsibilities

  • Design Shopify storefront experiences including homepages, product detail pages, collection pages, and cart/checkout flows optimized for conversion
  • Develop high-converting landing pages for paid media campaigns, promotional offers, and subscription acquisition
  • Translate CRO hypotheses and A/B test briefs into polished, production-ready design mockups using Figma
  • Apply direct response design principles to every deliverable, balancing visual quality with performance intent
  • Collaborate with CRO strategists to understand test objectives, user behavior data, and optimization priorities before beginning design work
  • Iterate rapidly on design concepts based on A/B test results, heatmap analysis, and qualitative feedback
  • Maintain and evolve client-specific design systems and component libraries in Figma to ensure brand consistency at scale
  • Handoff designs to developers with annotated specs, interaction notes, and responsive behavior defined
  • Review implemented pages against design intent and provide precise QA feedback prior to launch
  • Participate in client-facing design reviews and communicate design rationale clearly and professionally
  • Stay current on DTC eCommerce design trends, Shopify theme capabilities, and emerging CRO best practices


Requirements

  • 3+ years of UI design experience, with a portfolio demonstrating Shopify storefront and landing page work for eCommerce brands
  • Expert proficiency in Figma, including component libraries, auto layout, and developer handoff workflows
  • Deep understanding of direct response design principles and how layout, hierarchy, copy placement, and visual cues drive conversion
  • Proven experience designing within or alongside A/B testing frameworks (Intelligems, Convert, VWO, Optimizely, or similar)
  • Strong understanding of responsive design and mobile-first design principles
  • Ability to interpret quantitative data (CVR, bounce rate, scroll depth, heatmaps) and translate insights into design decisions
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to present and defend design decisions to internal teams and client stakeholders


Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Shopify theme structure, Liquid templating, or experience working directly within Shopify Online Store 2.0
  • Experience with tools such as Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, Google Optimize, or similar UX research and testing platforms
  • Basic proficiency in HTML/CSS sufficient to support developer QA and minor implementation edits
  • Background in DTC subscription brands or experience designing subscription-specific UX (subscribe-and-save, upsell flows, portal pages)
  • Motion or micro-interaction design experience using Figma prototyping or After Effects


Compensation and Benefits

  • Generous Time Off: Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Forensic Manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.


Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.


Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.


While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.


For more information, please see our video

Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.


While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.

title: Preparador de Casos de Imigração Sênior
description:
Estamos contratando um Senior Immigration Document Preparer com experiência comprovada em casos humanitários como VISTO T, VISTO U, VAWA e processos em COURT AMERICANA .

Essa posição é para profissionais que já trabalham com imigração , entendem a estrutura dos casos e conseguem preparar processos com alto nível de organização, precisão e responsabilidade.

Se você ainda está aprendendo ou nunca trabalhou diretamente com esses tipos de caso, essa vaga não é para você.

Responsabilidades

• Preparação completa de casos de imigração

• Organização e revisão de documentos

• Montagem de pacotes de aplicação

• Suporte à equipe jurídica

• Controle de prazos e deadlines

• Garantir consistência e precisão nos processos


Casos com os quais você irá trabalhar

• T Visa

• U Visa

• VAWA

• Asylum

• Immigration Court cases


Requisitos obrigatórios

• Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência REAL com imigração americana

• Experiência direta com T Visa, U Visa, VAWA, Asylum ou Court (Sabe o que são?)

• Perfil extremamente organizado e atento a detalhes

• Capacidade de trabalhar com prazos e grande volume de documentos

• Profissional proativo e focado em solução de problemas


Diferenciais

• Experiência prévia em law firm de imigração

• Conhecimento de processos em Immigration Court

• Experiência preparando casos humanitários complexos


Formato

Remote (Home Office)


Remuneração

Entre R$2.000 a R$6.000

(de acordo com experiência e performance)


Importante

Para se candidatar, inclua na aplicação:

1️⃣ Quantos anos você trabalha com imigração

2️⃣ Quais desses casos você já preparou:

T Visa / U Visa / VAWA / Asylum / Court

3️⃣ Em qual escritório ou empresa você adquiriu essa experiência

Aplicações sem essas informações serão desconsideradas automaticamente.

title: Electrical BIM Lead
description:
Eracore is an electrical engineering and BIM company delivering complex Electrical BIM models for large construction projects across the U.S. Our team brings together top talent to work on some of the most interesting and technically demanding electrical projects, including data centers, government facilities, industrial buildings, and advanced commercial projects.


We are proud of the work we do, and we invite you to take a look:


Eracore is growing in Brazil , and we are excited to welcome new team members. We are building a permanent and professional team to work on Electrical BIM projects for the U.S. market. If you enjoy teamwork, learning, and doing quality work, you will feel at home with us.


Why You’ll Enjoy Working at Eracore

  • Competitive hourly pay
  • Fully remote work
  • Learning platforms for professional growth
  • Supportive leadership and mentorship


Your Role

  • Lead and support the development of Electrical BIM models
  • Review models, perform clash detection, and ensure quality standards
  • Support and mentor BIM team members
  • Coordinate with other BIM trades
  • Prepare BIM documents such as reports, schedules, execution plans and shop drawings
  • Work daily with Revit and Navisworks and Bluebeam
  • Improve workflows and modeling processes when needed
  • Communicate clearly with client BIM teams throughout the project


What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in Electrical BIM
  • Strong understanding of electrical systems
  • Advanced Revit skills with an electrical focus
  • Experience using Navisworks for coordination and clash detection
  • Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, and Bluebeam
  • Team-oriented mindset with experience in managing the team
  • 2+ successfully finished projects
  • Reliable, organized, and deadline-focused

Eracore is growing in Brazil , and we are excited to welcome new team members. We are building a permanent and professional team to work on Electrical BIM projects for the U.S. market. If you enjoy teamwork, learning, and doing quality work, you will feel at home with us.


Why You’ll Enjoy Working at Eracore

  • Competitive hourly pay
  • Fully remote work
  • Learning platforms for professional growth
  • Supportive leadership and mentorship


Your Role

  • Lead and support the development of Electrical BIM models
  • Review models, perform clash detection, and ensure quality standards
  • Support and mentor BIM team members
  • Coordinate with other BIM trades
  • Prepare BIM documents such as reports, schedules, execution plans and shop drawings
  • Work daily with Revit and Navisworks and Bluebeam
  • Improve workflows and modeling processes when needed
  • Communicate clearly with client BIM teams throughout the project


What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in Electrical BIM
  • Strong understanding of electrical systems
  • Advanced Revit skills with an electrical focus
  • Experience using Navisworks for coordination and clash detection
  • Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, and Bluebeam
  • Team-oriented mindset with experience in managing the team
  • 2+ successfully finished projects
  • Reliable, organized, and deadline-focused

title: Technical Project Manager (AI Portfolio)
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Technical Project Manager (AI Portfolio) .


In this role you will:

  • Manage intake of AI use cases from CMC business and digital leadership, ensuring initiatives are clearly defined, prioritized, and actively managed
  • Ensure alignment between AI initiatives, business outcomes, and enterprise priorities
  • Drive portfolio-level actions, decisions, and follow-ups across multiple AI programs and workstreams
  • Identify interdependencies, risks, and capacity constraints across the portfolio and proactively drive resolution
  • Maintain standardized tracking for portfolio actions, statuses, risks, issues, and dependencies
  • Track and report on portfolio KPIs to provide insight on the portfolio status
  • Produce executive-ready reporting for leadership forums
  • Implement and evolve portfolio governance mechanisms, including intake, prioritization, and escalation processes
  • Drive continuous improvement in portfolio management practices, tooling, and reporting maturity
  • Facilitate portfolio-level forms, working sessions, and reviews
  • Lead projects as necessary:
  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans, milestone tracking, RAID logs, and governance materials
  • Drive execution of work, report on project statuses, and elevate risks, issues, and decisions to governing bodies
  • Ensure assigned projects adhere to applicable regulatory, validation, security, and data governance requirements
  • Influence without authority to drive accountability, resolve blockers, and maintain momentum


We have some requirements:

  • A bachelor’s degree in STEM or another relevant academic discipline
  • 5+ years in technical project or portfolio management
  • Demonstrated experience building and maintaining portfolio-level reporting and dashboards
  • Proven track record of on-time and in-budget project delivery
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively in cross-functional teams
  • Compliance-focused mindset
  • Familiarity with GxP, validation, or regulated environments
  • Experience working with AI/ML initiatives in life sciences
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently
  • Fluent English

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

  • Health insurance
  • Dental Plan
  • Life insurance
  • Transportation vouchers
  • Meal/Food Voucher
  • Childcare assistance
  • Totalpass
  • TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates
  • Partnership with SESC
  • Reimbursement of Certifications
  • Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training
  • International experience opportunity
  • Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools
  • Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire
  • TCS Gems – Recognition for performance
  • Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform
  • Tata Consultancy Services is an equal opportunity employer, our commitment to diversity & inclusion drives our efforts to provide equal opportunity to all candidates who meet our required knowledge & competency needs, irrespective of any socio-economic background, race, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity/expression , age, marital status, disability, sexual orientation or any others. We encourage anyone interested to build a career in TCS to participate in our recruitment & selection process.



At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.


Certificada pelo 7º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!


#Vempraília


Sobre a vaga:

  • Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para definir, projetar e lançar novos recursos;
  • Elaborar e conduzir refinamentos técnicos de demandas trazidas pelo time de produtos;
  • Atuar na manutenção da saúde e qualidade do codebase, equilibrando novas funcionalidades com resolução de débitos técnicos;
  • Desenvolver soluções escaláveis e que irão ser utilizadas por milhões de usuários;
  • Ser crítico em relação a Monitoria e Observabilidade;
  • Atuar na manutenção dos testes automatizados, incluindo criação de novos;
  • Orientar desenvolvedores de menor senioridade e auxiliar no desenvolvimento destes;
  • Elaboração de documentação técnica de novas funcionalidades;
  • Participar das cerimônias junto com os demais integrantes da equipe.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência com Java 17+, Spring Boot e Hibernate;
  • Experiência com Node.js + NestJS;
  • Experiência Bancos de Dados (SQL e NoSQL);
  • Oracle;
  • MongoDB;
  • RDS;
  • Experiência com comunicação por mensageria (RabbitMQ e SQS);
  • Experiência, compreensão e entendimento de arquitetura de micro serviços;
  • Experiência com Design de APIs REST;
  • Experiência com Testes Unitários (jUnit 5) e Testes Contrato (Pact);
  • Experiência com Axway - API Gateway;
  • Experiência com Git e Versionamento de Código;
  • Experiência com Dynatrace;
  • Conhecimento de Clean Code, Clean Architecture e Modularização;
  • Boas práticas de código, documentação e desenvolvimento de telas e componentes;
  • Experiência com em metodologias ágeis;
  • Excelentes habilidades para resolução de problemas e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Estar disposto a buscar novos conhecimentos e encarar novos desafios;
  • Experiencia em projetos de alta complexidade técnica e de processos.


Benefícios e Incentivos:

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Caju benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;

title: Mainframe Storage Engineer (CA tools specialist)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Storage Engineer (CA/Broadcom tols) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.


Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).


We are seeking an experienced Mainframe System Engineer to join our team and provide operational, consultancy, and migration support in a complex IBM Z environment. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in mainframe operations, storage administration , and migration projects involving IBM and CA products. This role requires strong technical proficiency, problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams to ensure seamless system operations and migrations.


Job responsibilities :

  • Manage and support mainframe operations, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Provide consultancy and technical assistance for migration projects
  • Implement and configure IBM storage solutions such as DFSMSrmm , DFSMShsm , and related advanced audit and reporting tools.
  • Assist with installation and configuration of IBM OMEGAMON for Storage and other monitoring tools.
  • Develop and maintain JCL scripts, REXX, and Assembler programs for automation and operational efficiency.
  • Utilize TSO and ISPF for system management and troubleshooting.
  • Collaborate with storage administrators to assess migration impacts and provide training/documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with system standards and best practices for SMP/E and z/OS environments.


Key skills :

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in mainframe operations, service, or support roles.
  • Experience with CA-1 Tape Management System .
  • Experience with CA FAVER, CA Allocate (installation, configuration, training).
  • Proficiency in TSO , ISPF , and JCL .
  • Ability to write REXX programs.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for documentation and stakeholder interaction.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of IBM Z system operation and configuration, including SMP/E .
  • Experience with IBM storage tools .
  • Familiarity with competing products and migration strategies.
  • Experience with Storage Administration on IBM Z .
  • Migration experience across IBM and CA products with ability to create customized JCL and runtime parameters.

title: Analytics Engineer Sênior (CLT) | Remoto
description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Engenheira Analítica de Dados Sênior para compor o time de Engenharia Analítica do Gran e mudar vidas com a gente!


O Gran é um ecossistema que une educação e tecnologia , que acelera e customiza o aprendizado para diferentes necessidades e momentos e que já impactou mais de 2 milhões de vidas. Hoje temos 2 verticais principais: a de Cursos Preparatórios e a Gran Faculdade.


Atualmente, são mais de 820 mil alunos e alunas , presentes em mais de 1.500 municípios brasileiros . Temos como motivação possibilitar uma educação de alta qualidade que seja diversa e inclusiva, geográfica e economicamente. Nossa tecnologia de ponta é um catalisador que impulsiona para muitas possibilidades de futuro.


Somos grandes defensores da ideia de que a educação é um direito de todos e fazemos o máximo para tornar isso uma realidade Brasil afora. Sabemos que a educação é a chave para muitos futuros possíveis e temos as ferramentas que facilitam o acesso de milhares de brasileiros ao ensino, em vários níveis.


Essa vaga está no nosso modelo de trabalho Gran Mundo , sendo 100% remoto. Dessa forma, você não precisa comparecer ao escritório, apenas em casos eventuais que serão avisados com antecedência e custeados pelo próprio Gran.


Todas as nossas vagas são no modelo de trabalho CLT.

description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Engenheira Analítica de Dados Sênior para compor o time de Engenharia Analítica do Gran e mudar vidas com a gente!


O Gran é um ecossistema que une educação e tecnologia , que acelera e customiza o aprendizado para diferentes necessidades e momentos e que já impactou mais de 2 milhões de vidas. Hoje temos 2 verticais principais: a de Cursos Preparatórios e a Gran Faculdade.

Sabemos que a educação é a chave para muitos futuros possíveis e temos as ferramentas que facilitam o acesso de milhares de brasileiros ao ensino, em vários níveis.


Essa vaga está no nosso modelo de trabalho Gran Mundo , sendo 100% remoto. Dessa forma, você não precisa comparecer ao escritório, apenas em casos eventuais que serão avisados com antecedência e custeados pelo próprio Gran.

title: 11161 - Desenvolvedor Salesforce
description:
Estamos em busca de Desenvolvedores Salesforce (Sêniores e Especialistas), altamente qualificados para atuarem em projetos estratégicos e de alta complexidade, com foco na implementação, customização e manutenção de soluções na plataforma Salesforce! ✨


Requisitos:

Graduação completa;

Possuir domínio avançado em Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce e SOQL;

Experiência prática com Salesforce DX, Git, CI/CD e gerenciamento de pacotes é essencial;

Deve ter conhecimento sólido no uso de ferramentas declarativas como Flow, Process Builder, Validation Rules e Permission Sets;

É fundamental ter experiência comprovada em integração de sistemas via APIs REST e SOAP, com autenticação OAuth 2.0 e uso de Named Credentials;

Conhecimento de arquitetura multiorganização (multi-org), gerenciamento de ambientes sandbox e estratégia de versionamento de código são importantes;

Desejável experiência com frameworks de testes automatizados e uso de ferramentas como Jest para LWC;

É esperado domínio dos módulos Sales Cloud e Service Cloud, além de conhecimento prático em gerenciamento de dados com Data Loader ou Workbench.


Certificações Salesforce são desejáveis, mas não obrigatórias, o foco está na experiência técnica comprovada em projetos complexos e de grande escala!

Outros diferenciais: Experiência com Financial Cloud, B2B commerce, CRM, Agentforce.


Responsabilidades :

Este profissional será responsável por desenvolver soluções robustas utilizando Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC) e outras tecnologias da plataforma, garantindo alta performance, escalabilidade e aderência às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento. A posição exige grande autonomia técnica, capacidade de análise crítica de requisitos e experiência com o ciclo completo de desenvolvimento dentro do ecossistema Salesforce, incluindo integração com sistemas externos e deploy controlado via Salesforce DX;

Liderará o desenvolvimento técnico de soluções na plataforma Salesforce, desde a análise de requisitos até a entrega em produção;

Deverá implementar funcionalidades customizadas utilizando Apex, LWC, Visualforce e configurações declarativas quando apropriado. Também será responsável por modelar objetos e relacionamentos no Salesforce Data Model, configurar workflows, Process Builder, Flow e validações de dados;

Espera-se que atue na integração da plataforma com APIs REST e SOAP externas, utilizando Named Credentials e Auth Providers quando necessário. Também será responsável por garantir a qualidade do código através de testes unitários com alta cobertura, revisão de código e aplicação de design patterns aderentes ao Salesforce;

Participará ativamente de cerimônias ágeis, colaborando com equipes multidisciplinares e orientando desenvolvedores menos experientes.


Modalidade de trabalho: 100% Home-Office, podendo residir em qualquer região do Brasil!!!

Contratação: CLT Flex

title: Oracle EBS + WebLogic Administrator
description:
Job Title: Oracle EBS + WebLogic Administrator

Location: Brazil (Remote)


Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced Oracle EBS + WebLogic Administrator with 6+ years of experience and strong understanding of EBS R12.2 architecture .


Responsibilities:

  • Oracle WebLogic software installation and maintenance (11.x, 12.x, 14.x)
  • Installing WebLogic patches, service packs, and applying utilities like WebLogic.Admin, WebLogic.Deployer
  • WebLogic application server administration, performance monitoring, and tuning
  • Thread dump and heap dump analysis
  • Configuring LDAP and security realms (basic)
  • Developing automation scripts and integrating with HTTP servers
  • Troubleshooting JAR, EAR, WAR files
  • Understanding of EBS with 2 DB Rack System, EXADATA & ASM
  • EBS patching using ADOP (R12.2), CPU patching on DB/EBS/Tech stack
  • Cloning (Oracle DB 19c and EBS R12.2)
  • Renewing SSL and other trusted certificates on EBS
  • Understanding WebLogic server and applying patches
  • Experience with Oracle Multitenant DB architecture (19c), DR (Data Guard – Physical Standby), RMAN and DB restore
  • Shell scripting and routine Oracle Apps DBA activities


Qualifications:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in middleware administration , WebLogic, and Oracle Apps DBA tasks

title: Desenvolvedor ServiceNow | Especialista Técnico de Aplicações
description:
Descrição da Vaga (JD):

O desenvolvedor ServiceNow fará parte de uma equipe já estabelecida, apoiando a implementação do módulo Application Portfolio Management (APM) do ServiceNow. O profissional será responsável por ativar e configurar o módulo, além de trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times funcionais para definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema.


Como Especialista Técnico de Aplicações, você poderá esperar:

▪ Formular e definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema.

▪ Ser responsável pelo design do programa, codificação, testes, depuração e documentação.

▪ Ter conhecimento técnico e responsabilidade por todas as fases de análise e programação de sistemas de aplicações.

▪ Compreender o negócio ou a função para a qual a aplicação está sendo projetada.

▪ Aprender continuamente sobre novas tecnologias, gerar novas ideias e melhorar o uso de tecnologias modernas em todo o portfólio de aplicações.

▪ Configurar e ativar o Application Portfolio Management (APM).

▪ Desenvolver relacionamentos de Itens de Configuração (CIs) para Capacidades de Negócio, Objetos de Informação, Aplicações de Negócio e Serviços de Aplicação.

▪ Integrar o APM com outros módulos do ServiceNow, incluindo ITSM e SAM.

▪ Utilizar fortes competências técnicas e expertise para identificar, analisar e solucionar problemas em produção, mantendo procedimentos que atendam às expectativas dos usuários de negócio.

▪ Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes multifuncionais e times de desenvolvimento para entender e fornecer soluções/correções automatizadas.

▪ Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de Delivery e Suporte, bem como para a maturidade dos diferentes portfólios, capacidades, especializações e melhores práticas, considerando as necessidades e requisitos dos usuários e stakeholders.

▪ Participar de eventos SCRUM e concluir os itens atribuídos dentro da meta definida para a Sprint.

▪ Reunir-se com stakeholders-chave e acompanhar os itens de ação para quaisquer soluções alternativas necessárias, de acordo com a natureza dos requisitos.

Qualificações e Requisitos


Qualificações essenciais

• Graduação ou Mestrado em Computação, Eletrônica ou área relacionada

• Certificação ServiceNow System Administrator (CSA)

• Certificação ServiceNow Certified Application Portfolio Management (APM) Implementer

• Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de comunicar informações técnicas para públicos não técnicos


Competências-chave

▪ 8 a 10 anos de experiência total na área de TI

▪ Conhecimento intermediário em linguagens de desenvolvimento: XML, HTML, CSS, Java e JavaScript

▪ Experiência na plataforma ServiceNow como Administrador e Desenvolvedor

▪ Experiência no desenvolvimento de Service Catalogs, implementação de ACLs, transform maps, Flows via Flow Designer, client scripts e métricas de saúde da CMDB

▪ Configuração de Assessments, Demands, Business Capability Maps e Information Objects

▪ Mais de 5 anos de experiência em administração ServiceNow nas seguintes áreas: Service Catalog, CMDB & Discovery, Service Portal, Workflows, Dashboards, REST APIs

▪ Experiência prévia com o módulo APM é desejável


Outras habilidades e competências

▪ Capacidade de adaptação rápida para aprender novas ferramentas, novas tecnologias e padrões atuais do mercado

▪ Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente global e distribuído, sem supervisão

▪ Perfil autodirigido, proativo e com pensamento sistêmico

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.



Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.


Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.
